verdict.rationale: Loops ships event-triggered workflows that run unattended once published. Onboarding, activation, upgrade and winback sequences are set up once and fire as product events arrive (loops-docs-15, loops-docs-30, loops-docs-3). Agents can also create, branch and edit workflow graphs from code, start them via events, or trigger them through webhooks and Zapier/Make (loops-docs-27, loops-docs-52, loops-docs-37). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow automation, and thin documentation on runtime behavior such as delays, scheduling and run monitoring.
